def title_of(html: str) -> str:
    """Text between the first `<title>` and the next `</title>` in html, or "" if either tag is missing."""
    post out.byte_len() <= html.byte_len()
    ex title_of("<html><head><title>Hello</title></head></html>") == "Hello"
    ex title_of("<html></html>") == ""
    ex title_of("<title>unclosed") == ""
    ex title_of("<title></title>") == ""
    before, open_sep, rest = html.partition("<title>")
    if open_sep == "":
        return ""
    title, close_sep, after = rest.partition("</title>")
    if close_sep == "":
        return ""
    return title.copy()
